publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Guilherme Sabino

record.title: A fixed USB delay did not admit lockdownd
record.method: Measured startup delay and matched host/device mux frames
record.observation: A measured 30.0155-second soft-connect delay still receives stock ECONNREFUSED and RST at the local lockdownd connection. Matched complete mux frames narrow the fault beyond EP0.
record.limits: The fixed-delay hypothesis is not sufficient; this is not proof of broken TCP or an absent baseband. Whole usbmon capture completeness remains false.
